summary.intent: Execute all 5 plans for Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) via the GSD manager — parallel worktree execution, code review, fix application, and phase verification.
summary.outcome: Phase 50 fully complete: all 5 plans merged (INT_MIN overflow fix, refcount-aware drain, on-demand subtree IPNS traversal with cycle guard, D-04 dispositions, unpin-integrity fixes + api-client regen), 2 code-review blockers fixed, verification passed 3/3 must-haves, phase marked complete, 2 resolved todos closed. /simplify pass initiated but not yet landed.

repo: orval/pnpm api:generate resolves to the workspace root, not the worktree — any worktree that runs pnpm install or api:generate leaks regenerated api-client (132 files) and openapi.json into the main checkout's working tree.
Husky regenerates .husky/_/* stubs in any worktree that runs pnpm install, leaving untracked files that block the cleanup-wave merge helper.

The GSD merge helper's internal commit silently fails when lint-staged (eslint+prettier) runs across 131 staged api-client files — the helper reports opaque merge_failed with empty stderr; completing the merge manually with hooks enabled works fine.
The GSD commit helper false-negatives: reports commit_failed but git log confirms the commit landed. Do not retry.
todos/done/ (70 items, frozen ~2026-06-15) and todos/completed/ (20 items, current canonical) coexist — GSD tooling references completed/ exclusively; done/ is unmigrated legacy drift.
phase.complete warns about missing REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) in REQUIREMENTS traceability — pre-existing doc-sync debt, not a phase failure.
The GSD init.manager dep-parser mis-parses 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into a phantom phase '1.1', marking deps unsatisfied even when Phase 49 is complete.
worktree base-check result 'baseref-head' means executors fork off current HEAD — PLAN files are always present in forked worktrees without additional setup.

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync lacked a visited set for cycle detection despite docstring claiming to mirror ensureFolderLoaded DFS pattern; siblings ensureFolderLoaded (line 549) and the shared walker (line 2526) both carry one. Fixed in code-review follow-up.
After fix: visited guard added as parameter (line 286) with early-return guard (line 293-294) and child-skip (line 327-341).

4 fire-and-forget bin-unenroll dispatch sites had no .catch() handlers — unhandled promise rejections on failure. Fixed; /simplify followup will consolidate into a single fireAndForgetUnenrollEntries helper.

WR-01: refcount recheck and physical unpin happen outside the advisory lock in the drain path — data-loss race window. Fixed by moving unpin inside lock scope. Accepted trade-off: lock now held across Kubo network call on a low-frequency batched path.

IN-06: outboxRowInserted renamed to shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin for clarity. IN-01: fileUnpins.inc() now gated by rowDeleted flag — no longer fires on no-op paths. IN-03: recordUnpin deleted (zero callers).

workflow: When a wave merge fails with empty stderr, check whether the pre-commit hook (check-api-client.sh + lint-staged) is timing out or silently failing the merge helper's internal commit — completing the merge manually with hooks enabled resolves it.

After parallel worktrees run pnpm operations, always inspect main checkout dirty state before merging; leaked generated files from worktrees can be safely discarded once confirmed to match the incoming worktree's committed content.

Key-link forward-reference artifacts (parser treating an upcoming wave's own deliverable as a missing prior dependency) can be ignored — verify by checking that the actual prior-wave files are present on HEAD.
GSD phase.complete REQ-ID warnings are surfaced by gsd-tools checking REQUIREMENTS.md traceability — separate from HARD-01 verification; pre-existing gaps don't block completion.
TDD gate: each type:tdd plan must have a clean RED test commit followed by a GREEN fix commit — reviewable via git log per-plan. Disposition plans (50-04/50-05) are exempt.

friction: orval/pnpm api:generate leaked 132 api-client files + openapi.json from the 50-05 worktree into main checkout — blocked cleanup-wave merge; required manual dirty-state inspection, content verification, and discard before re-merging.
Husky stubs (.husky/_/*) generated in 50-05 worktree blocked initial cleanup-wave merge as untracked files — required explicit clean step before retry.

GSD merge helper silently failed its internal hook-gated commit (lint-staged across 131 staged files) and returned opaque merge_failed with empty stderr — required manual diagnosis and manual merge completion.
GSD commit helper false-negative: reports commit_failed on docs(phase-50) tracking commits but git log confirms commits landed — creates unnecessary uncertainty.
GSD init.manager mis-parses phase dependency strings containing version numbers (e.g. 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)'), creating phantom phase '1.1' and falsely marking deps unsatisfied.
mktemp on macOS BSD doesn't substitute XXXXXX in the middle of a template path — minor but creates non-standard temp filenames.
Bash pipe masking exit codes on typecheck runs — required re-running without pipe to confirm BUILD_EXIT=0.
